title: Bright Blue toolbar for Excalidraw
summary: Bright Blue separates navigation and shapes from a prominent cobalt Draw button, and underlines the active tool so it's clear without relying on color. It's now the default toolbar.

variations.name: Bright Blue
variations.idea: Separate selection and shapes from a cobalt Draw button, and underline the active tool.
variations.why: The Draw button is easy to spot, and tool groups are clearly separated.
